Escudero]] | blank1_name = Political party | blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Nationalist People's Coalition}}|border=darkgray}} [[Nationalist People's Coalition|NPC]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''Sorsogon's 1st congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Sorsogon]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 14, 2020}} The district consists of the provincial capital, [[Sorsogon City]], and adjacent municipalities of [[Casiguran, Sorsogon|Casiguran]], [[Castilla, Sorsogon|Castilla]], [[Donsol]], [[Magallanes, Sorsogon|Magallanes]] and [[Pilar, Sorsogon|Pilar]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Maria Bernadette G. Escudero]] of the [[Nationalist People's Coalition]] (NPC).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=May 13, 2023}} Prior to its second dissolution in 1972, it consisted of the eastern municipalities of [[Barcelona, Sorsogon|Barcelona]], [[Bulan, Sorsogon|Bulan]], [[Bulusan, Sorsogon|Bulusan]], [[Gubat, Sorsogon|Gubat]], [[Irosin]], [[Matnog]], [[Prieto Diaz]], and [[Santa Magdalena, Sorsogon|Santa Magdalena]]. The municipality of Casiguran was first part of this district until it was reapportioned to the [[Sorsogon's 2nd congressional district|second district]] effective 1922 as a result of the establishment of [[Masbate]] as an independent province in 1920.{{cite PH act|chamber=Act|number=2934|url=https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/28/36174 |title=An Act Authorizing the Separation of the Subprovinee of Masbate From the Province of Sorsogon and the Reestablishment of the Former Province of Masbate, and for Other Purposes.|date=December 20, 1920 |publisher=Lawyerly |accessdate=October 7, 2025}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
